mapper.select: SELECT SUM(c.credit) FROM biz_course c INNER JOIN biz_student_course sc ON c.id = sc.teaching_class_id WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId}
SELECT c.course_name AS courseName, sc.score AS score, sc.credit AS credit FROM biz_course c INNER JOIN biz_student_course sc ON c.id = sc.teaching_class_id WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT * FROM (SELECT s.student_no AS studentId, sys.real_name AS studentName, IFNULL(SUM(sc.score), 0) AS totalScore, COUNT(sc.id) AS studentCount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(sc.score) DESC) AS ranking From sys_user sys LEFT JOIN biz_student s ON s.student_no = sys.id LEFT JOIN biz_student_course sc ON s.student_no = sc.student_id GROUP BY sys.id, sys.real_name) AS rank_table WHERE studentId = #{studentId}
